all.src: Short strikes by delta 0.20-0.30 on each side, symmetric within 0.07 delta.
Max loss per side (width x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity.
LEVEL 3 OK: each short is covered by a same-side long at a protective strike in a LATER expiry. Submit as a single 4-leg mleg; if it must be legged, fill BOTH WINGS FIRST, then sell both shorts.
all.note: SAFETY: without this the short leg is uncovered

management.src: Take profit at 50% of the total credit.
